test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-4) Official paper (Held On: 10 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: To do a certain work, the ratio of the efficiencies of A, B and C is 3 ∶ 5 ∶ 8. Working together, they can complete the same work in 15 days. If only A and B work together for 12 days and leave, and then C comes to complete the remaining work, for how many days will C work?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total efficiency = 3 + 5 + 8 = 16 units/day.

Total work = Total efficiency × Total days = 16 × 15 = 240 units.

Work done by **A** and **B** in 12 days = (3 + 5) × 12 = 96 units.

Remaining work = 240 − 96 = 144 units.

Time taken by **C** = Remaining work ÷ Efficiency of **C** = 144 ÷ 8 = 18 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given efficiencies: **A** = 3, **B** = 5, **C** = 8.

Working together, **(A + B + C)** completes work in 15 days.

⇒ Total work = 15 × 16 = 240 units.

⇒ Efficiency of **A + B** = 3 + 5 = 8 units/day.

⇒ Work completed by **A** and **B** in 12 days = 12 × 8 = 96 units.

⇒ Remaining work = 240 − 96 = 144 units.

⇒ Time taken by **C** to finish remaining work = 144 ÷ 8 = 18 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency and Time Relationship

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken to complete the work (Efficiency ∝ 1 ÷ Time).

Work and Wages

Wages are generally distributed among workers in the ratio of the work done by them, which is the same as the ratio of their efficiencies if they work for the same duration.

Pipes and Cisterns

This concept is identical to Time and Work, where the efficiency of an inlet pipe is positive and the efficiency of an outlet/leakage pipe is negative.</p
